title: 第1024章 联盟会议疑云重重第1023章 暗流激涌援军终至
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
白帝府议事厅的灵能灯全部亮了起来。
战前这里只有稀稀拉拉的几盏灯亮着，为了节省灵能屏障消耗而刻意压低一切不必要的能量开支。
此刻段奕的舰队悬停在白帝城上空，三艘战列级星舰的灵能护盾与内城区的屏障形成双重防护，白无尘终于舍得把灯全部打开。
灯火通明之中，整座议事厅呈现出一种与战时的破败截然不同的庄重。
穹顶上铭刻的白帝族徽被灵能激活后散发着柔和的银白光芒，将长桌两侧每一张面孔都照得纤毫毕现。
段奕坐在长桌左侧首位，军装笔挺，左眼下那道暗红色的旧伤疤在银白光芒下泛着淡淡的金属光泽。
他身后站着两名副官，一个捧着数据板，一个手按刀柄，站姿如标枪般笔直。
宋知意坐在段奕下首。
这位八阶医修看上去不过三十出头的模样，但那双浅琥珀色的眼睛里透出的沉静与老练，让任何稍有阅历的人都能看出她的真实年龄远比外貌大得多。
她从落座起就在翻阅苏墨提供的那份尸鬼病毒数据报告，指尖在全息屏上快速划动，神情专注而凝重。
那位身份不明的黑袍顾问坐在长桌的最末端，离灯火最亮处刻意拉开了几分距离。
兜帽依旧压得极低，那截苍白的下巴在阴影中若隐若现。
白无尘坐在主位，肩头的银白族徽与穹顶的徽记遥相呼应，面色比刚从封印空间出来时好了几分，却仍掩不住眼底那层挥之不去的倦意。
苏墨坐在段奕对面，赵敢当、雷战、李军三人分列他身后。
铁临渊坐在白无尘右手边，他的气色比战后那会儿强了些，握着手杖的指节也不再发颤。
段奕没有寒暄，直接开门见山。
“沈映代首席向萧总首提交的紧急军报，萧总首亲自批阅，跳过军事调度处直接签发调令。”
他的声音不高，却带着军人特有的利落。
“第三机动舰队抽调三艘战列舰、十二艘护卫舰、两艘医疗舰，携三个满编陆战旅的兵力，已于半个时辰前完成白帝星外围的空间封锁。
从现在起，没有我的命令，任何舰船不得进出白帝星。”

他顿了顿，目光扫过长桌两侧所有人，最后落在苏墨身上：
“但在制定下一步作战计划之前，我需要知道白帝城目前最真实的状况。
沈映代首席的军报写得很详细，但军报毕竟是数日前发出的，战场上瞬息万变。
林团长，你是一直守在这里的，直接说说你的判断。”
苏墨点了点头，没有多余的客套。
“先说好消息。”
他竖起第一根手指，“尸鬼病毒的扩散速度已经被遏制住了。
外城区地底的尸鬼母巢在前段时间被摧毁，核心目前在我手里。
母巢崩塌后，所有尸鬼失去了意识连接，从协同作战退化回了各自为战的散兵游勇。
内城区的灵能屏障短期内不会受到大规模威胁。”
“再说坏消息。”
苏墨继续道，“黑袍虚影还在，尸鬼病毒还在变异。
他在母巢被毁时亲自现身，口中说母巢是失败的实验，但从始至终他都表现得太过从容——从容到好像母巢被毁这件事本身也是他的计划。”
content_en:
All the psychic lights in the Baidi Mansion's meeting hall lit up.
Before the war, there were only a few sparse lights on here, and all unnecessary energy expenditures were deliberately kept down in order to save consumption of psychic barriers.
At this moment, Duan Yi's fleet was hovering over Baidi City. The psychic shields of the three battle-class starships and the inner city barrier formed a double protection. Bai Wuchen was finally willing to turn on all the lights.
Under the bright lights, the entire conference hall showed a solemnity that was completely different from the dilapidation during the war.
The Baidi clan emblem engraved on the dome was activated by spiritual energy and emitted soft silvery light, illuminating every face on both sides of the long table.
Duan Yi sat at the head of the left side of the long table. His military uniform was straight and the old dark red scar under his left eye glowed with a faint metallic luster under the silver light.
Two lieutenants stood behind him. One was holding a data tablet, and the other was pressing the hilt of a knife. They stood as straight as a javelin.
Song Zhiyi sat under Duan Yi.
This eighth-level medical cultivator looks like she is only in her early thirties, but the calmness and sophistication in her light amber eyes allow anyone with a little experience to see that her true age is much older than her appearance.
She had been flipping through the ghoul virus data report provided by Su Mo since she sat down. Her fingertips were swiping rapidly on the holographic screen, her expression focused and solemn.
The unidentified black-robed consultant sat at the end of the long table, deliberately keeping some distance away from the brightest light.
The hood was still pressed very low, and the pale chin was looming in the shadow.
Bai Wuchen was sitting in the main seat. The silver-white clan emblem on his shoulders echoed the emblem on the dome. His face looked a little better than when he just came out of the sealed space, but he still couldn't hide the lingering tiredness in his eyes.
Su Mo sat opposite Duan Yi, and Zhao Gandang, Lei Zhan, and Li Jun lined up behind him.
Tie Linyuan sat on Bai Wuchen's right hand. His complexion was stronger than before the war, and his knuckles holding the cane no longer trembled.
Duan Yi went straight to the point without exchanging pleasantries.
"Acting Chief Shen Ying submitted an emergency military report to Commander-in-Chief Xiao. Commander-in-Chief Xiao personally reviewed it and directly issued the transfer order, skipping the military dispatch office."
His voice was not high-pitched, but it had the distinct crispness of a soldier.
"The Third Mobile Fleet deployed three battleships, twelve frigates, two hospital ships, and three full marine brigades to complete the space blockade outside the White Emperor Star half an hour ago.
From now on, no ships are allowed to enter or exit Baidi Star without my order. "
He paused and glanced at everyone on both sides of the long table, finally landing on Su Mo:
“But before formulating the next battle plan, I need to know the most real situation at Baidi City.
Acting Chief Shen Ying's military report was very detailed, but after all, it was sent out a few days ago, and the battlefield was changing rapidly.
Captain Lin, you have been staying here, please tell me your judgment directly. "
Su Mo nodded without any extra courtesy.
"The good news first."
He raised his first finger and said, "The spread of the ghoul virus has been contained.
The ghoul nest underground in the outer city was destroyed some time ago, and the core is currently in my hands.
After the nest collapsed, all the ghouls lost their consciousness connection, and degenerated from coordinated operations back to individual stragglers.
The psychic barrier in the inner city will not be threatened on a large scale in the short term. "
"More bad news."
Su Mo continued, "The black-robed shadow is still there, and the ghoul virus is still mutating.
He showed up in person when the Brood Nest was destroyed, saying that the Brood Nest was a failed experiment, but he acted too calmly from beginning to end - so calm that it seemed that the destruction of the Brood Nest itself was his plan. "
